summary.text: Donald Ardell is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives who has represented District 6 since December 6, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former federal criminal investigator and immigration agent, he lives in Monticello, Maine.

paragraphs.text: Donald Ardell lives in Monticello, Maine, and earned a B.A. in fine arts and criminology from the State University of New York at Plattsburgh in 1995.
His career experience includes working as a federal criminal investigator and immigration agent.
Ardell was assigned to the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee in 2023-2024 and the House Engrossed Bills Committee in 2025-2026.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
